title: Not as described:  They blink/strobe
text: Not as described:  They blink/strobe. I bought these to put into a Christmas wreath.  Unfortunately, they are not a solid strand but instead rapidly blink (think strobe-style speeds).  The description said nothing about them blinking.  I don't see a switch to change to solid.  I have no way of contacting the seller.  Very disappointing as I can't use them now so they're a waste of money.
